name: m1_bgm_edit3
note: 用户 2026-10-02 第三次试听：上一轮换音色 4 版都不好——开头那件弹拨乐太薄太亮、听不清；也不要换成琵琶，因为 0:29–0:35 已用琵琶，前面再用就重复。本轮只换 0:03–0:09：描述里指定中阮（温厚圆润的中低音区）或中低音区古筝，加噪保留度降到 0.4 / 0.55 给换乐器留空间；0:29–0:35 保持种子 11 原样，另附两版“琵琶更饱满”供选。

edits.title: 首领战 · 0:03–0:09 开头弹拨乐换中阮
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) boss battle music for a video game, high-fidelity studio recording. The plucked melody is played on a zhongruan (Chinese moon-shaped lute): warm, round, full-bodied mid-low register, clearly articulated and present in the mix, not thin, not bright, not liuqin, not pipa. Driving Chinese war drums and a staccato low string ostinato underneath. Tense, dark and thrilling. No vocals, no electric guitar, no synthesizer.

edits.title: 首领战 · 0:03–0:09 开头弹拨乐换中低音区古筝
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) boss battle music for a video game, high-fidelity studio recording. The plucked melody is played on a guzheng in its low and middle register: deep, resonant, full-bodied strings, clearly articulated and present in the mix, not thin, not bright, not pipa. Driving Chinese war drums and a staccato low string ostinato underneath. Tense, dark and thrilling. No vocals, no electric guitar, no synthesizer.

edits.title: （可选）首领战 · 0:29–0:35 琵琶更饱满
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) boss battle music for a video game, high-fidelity studio recording. Tense pipa tremolo and rapid strumming with a full, rich, resonant body and clear attack, not thin. Driving Chinese war drums, a staccato string ostinato and short low brass accents. Tense and thrilling, constant forward momentum. No vocals, no electric guitar, no synthesizer.
